Metadata.title: Findly — lost and found items
Metadata.description: Report a lost or found item and the system automatically finds possible matches.

Home.title: Find what you lost. <accent>Connect with the finder.</accent>
Home.subtitle: Findly connects people who lost items with those who found them — through smart search and automatic matching of reports.

heroCard.title: A possible match
heroCard.description: We'll notify you as soon as a report matches yours.

Home.heroImageAlt: A young woman hands a found item back to its smiling owner

report.title: Report
report.description: Describe the item, add photos, a date and a location on the map.

match.title: Automatic matching
match.description: The system compares reports and shows you the most likely matches.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Talk to the other person through messages and get the item back.

latestDescription.lost: Did you find one of these? Open the report and contact the owner.
latestDescription.found: Is one of these yours? Open the report and contact the finder.

latestEmpty.lost: No lost items have been reported yet.
